name: @holisticconsulting/evalgate
description: A pre-merge quality gate for LLM features. Scores output against committed cases in CI and fails the build on regression.
author: Chris Short

scripts.example: tsc && node dist/cli.js run --suite examples/support-agent --sut examples/support-agent/sut.mjs --no-cache
scripts.example:calibrate: tsc && node dist/cli.js calibrate --set examples/support-agent/calibration.yaml --judge examples/support-agent/sut.mjs
